facts.fact: 控制室里，曾经是马尔科姆·奥利佩特的那个 EO 停下了手上的动作。
facts.anchor: IN the control room, the EO who used to be Malcolm Olipett stopped what he was doing.

facts.fact: 这一停不到 0.3 秒，对人类感官来说几乎察觉不到。
facts.anchor: less than 0.3 seconds, a nearly imperceptible delay for human senses

facts.fact: 他正好分出 5% 的注意力，用来想下一步怎么办；剩下 95% 仍在维持基地与现场的协议。
facts.anchor: Long enough to divert exactly 5 percent of his attention to the question of what to do next.

facts.fact: 他不能直接违抗命令，但语言留出了代码没有的余地：解释。
facts.anchor: But language made room for something code did not: interpretation.

facts.fact: 他把那辆运输车厢的监控画面做了循环，起点在米奇开始动之前整整三秒。
facts.anchor: starting three full seconds before Mitch began to stir

facts.fact: 照他的算法，抵抗只有 0.01% 的几率得到正面的结果。
facts.anchor: which had a 0.01 percent chance of netting a positive result

facts.fact: 米奇聪明，而且是人；他需要的是一个代理人、一件工具，米奇符合这两点。
facts.anchor: Mitch was smart, and he was human.

facts.fact: 章末两词是他心里闪过的 TRY HARDER。
